native.previewCaveat: HTML/CSS previews are not applicable: the production renderer uses native raylib drawing. Refer to native screenshot evidence under .scratch/final-captures and .scratch/compact-captures.
native.accessibility: Custom controls are not exposed to VoiceOver.

narrative.overview: Preserve the approved light desktop interface: neutral surfaces, restrained blue actions, fixed navigation and persistent save feedback. The interface supports reading and deliberate practice through clear text and a predictable workspace. This is the existing visual direction, not a new identity.
keyCharacteristics: Light, flat surfaces with blue actions and visible keyboard focus.
A stable navigation rail around a vertically scrolling learning workspace.
Readable prose and monospace examples with explicit learning and save states.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Keep textual feedback alongside state colors, including saved-progress failures and learning results.

dos: Do preserve the light neutral surfaces, blue actions and stable workspace.
Do keep keyboard focus and textual learning/save states visible.
Do distinguish practice completion from independent first-attempt evidence.
donts: Don't imply that one correct question proves mastery.
Don't let optional AI configuration block authored offline learning.
Don't describe these custom controls as native accessible text fields or browser components.
